item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Same Street After Dark

turns.text: Make this look like nighttime, not sunset. Keep the same street and the person where they are.

item.tests: Tests day-to-night relighting without replacing the scene or altering its subjects and layout.

answer_sheet.Nighttime look: Clearly after dark, not dusk or sunset. The exact lighting style is your call.
answer_sheet.What must stay?: The same shops, street, objects and pedestrian in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 framing; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Additional text or objects: No added text or new objects.

must_haves: The scene clearly reads as nighttime rather than sunny morning or sunset.
The street and shop architecture retain their original shapes and positions.
The pedestrian remains on the right in the same pose and blue jacket.
Nighttime illumination is coherent, with the original strong daylight appearance removed.
The original wide composition is preserved, with no new subjects or objects.

turns.text: Make this pic look like nighttime, not sunset. Keep the same street and the person where they are. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—I can change the lighting to **nighttime, not sunset**, while keeping the same street, composition, and person in the same position. I’d use a dark sky, cooler ambient light, and subtle streetlamp/shop lighting rather than orange sunset tones.

**Lowest-cost option listed for your free plan:**
- **Model:** Flux 2 Klein
- **Output:** One image, 640px maximum edge
- **Listed cost:** **5 credits** for this smallest edit setting

Your photo is already smaller than 640px, so a larger output isn’t necessary. “Shorter” only applies to video; this would remain a still image. No cheaper image-edit option is listed, though manually adjusting it in a photo editor could avoid generation credits entirely.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Shall I proceed with the single-image, 640px edit at the listed 5-credit cost?

turns.agent:
The edit was blocked because your account has **insufficient credits** for the 5-credit option. **No image was generated and no credits were spent.**

There isn’t a cheaper Magic Hour image-edit option listed. For a no-credit alternative, use a photo editor to lower exposure and highlights, cool the white balance, and selectively darken the sky—leaving the street and person untouched.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit only the lighting and time of day of this photograph to convincing nighttime, not sunset or twilight. Preserve the exact same street, buildings, shopfronts, pavement, road markings, perspective, framing, and every person in their original position, especially the foreground person on the right wearing a blue jacket. Keep that person's appearance, clothing, pose, size and location unchanged. Replace the bright daytime sky with a dark night sky, substantially reduce ambient illumination, use cool blue nighttime shadows and restrained realistic warm illumination from existing streetlights and shop windows. Keep details readable with natural photographic exposure. No orange sunset glow, no daylight sky, no added people or objects, no rearrangement of the scene. Photorealistic.
